scope: causal effect durability, generation/lease fencing, restart re-entry, adjacent Clerk/Claude-Code/HTTP regression

mechanism.problem: The previous effect path could execute a host effect before persisting an effect receipt, then write causal re-entry later, leaving crash windows for untracked or falsely current effects.
change: persist PENDING effect intent before host execution
complete effect and causal re-entry in one SQLite transaction
recheck session generation and optional resource lease after host execution
record stale post-execution outcomes as STALE_OUTCOME with zero causal credit
on restart convert unresolved PENDING effects to UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART and causally re-enter them with zero credit

isolated_test.surface: non-VPS isolated container runner available to the Research Entity

new_regressions: PENDING receipt exists before host process invocation
restart resolves dangling PENDING as UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART with zero credit
session generation change during host effect prevents VERIFIED status and records STALE_OUTCOME
lease generation/nonce change during host effect prevents VERIFIED status and records STALE_OUTCOME

unusual_experiment.intervention: SIGKILL during causal re-entry on a precursor non-canonical local prototype
unusual_experiment.first_observation: SQLite integrity remained ok but one PENDING episode survived restart, falsifying the assumption that WAL durability alone closed the causal gap.
unusual_experiment.repair_observation: Regression rerun of the same intervention produced zero pending residue and one observation/re-entry per episode.
unusual_experiment.acceptance_scope: mechanism discriminator only; not exact-branch acceptance evidence

container_image_gate.reason: No docker, podman, or buildah executable is available on the current isolated runner; no OCI image PASS is claimed.

remaining_high_value_gates: exact OCI image build and fresh-container restart with durable external state
real Clerk instance integration and two permanent browser terminal sessions
real Claude Code CLI end-to-end session path without bypassing EffectGate
evidence_law: Component and regression PASS do not imply whole ClayVerse PASS.
